title: How Far Can the Gemma 4 Speech Encoder Go Without Changing Its Weights? Saudi and Gulf Arabic Speech Recognition with a Frozen and an Adapter-Augmented Encoder
abstract: arXiv:2610.28673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the 305M-parameter audio encoder shared by Gemma 4 and EmbeddingGemma 2 (identical except for its final projection) for Saudi and Gulf Arabic speech recognition, without changing any of its weights. A frozen system trains only a 22.6M-parameter CTC reader over a mix of encoder layers; an adapted system adds 3.1M low-rank adapter parameters, a 41.5M-parameter hybrid CTC/attention reader and joint decoding with a sub-word language model. Against Cohere Transcribe Arabic (2.07B parameters), re-run on identical audio, the frozen system trails in word error rate (WER) but is statistically indistinguishable in character error rate (CER) on five of six human-labelled conditions, while running 3.4 times faster on CPU with greedy decoding. The adapted system is statistically indistinguishable in WER on a public Saudi customer-service call (19.20% against 19.27%) and on clean Emirati speech, is significantly better on telephone-coded Emir

translated_title: 不改变任何权重的 Gemma 4 语音编码器能走多远？基于冻结编码器与适配器增强编码器的沙特阿拉伯语和海湾阿拉伯语语音识别
translated_abstract: 我们研究了 Gemma 4 与 EmbeddingGemma 2 共享的 3.05 亿参数音频编码器（两者除最终投影层外完全相同），在不改变其任何权重的情况下将其用于沙特阿拉伯语和海湾阿拉伯语语音识别。冻结系统仅在编码器多个层特征的混合之上训练一个 2260 万参数的 CTC 读取器；适配增强系统则额外增加 310 万个低秩适配器参数、一个 4150 万参数的混合 CTC/注意力读取器，以及与子词语言模型的联合解码。与在相同音频上重新运行的 Cohere Transcribe Arabic（20.7 亿参数）相比，冻结系统在词错误率（WER）上略逊一筹，但在六个人工标注测试条件中的五个上，字符错误率（CER）在统计上不相上下，同时在使用贪婪解码时在 CPU 上的运行速度快 3.4 倍。适配增强系统在公开的沙特客服通话数据上的 WER（19.20% 对 19.27%）以及在干净的阿联酋语音上与对方在统计上不相上下，而在电话编码的阿联酋语音上则显著更优……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 在完全不改变 Gemma 4 语音编码器权重的前提下，仅通过轻量级 CTC 读取器或少量低秩适配器参数，就能让沙特和海湾阿拉伯语语音识别达到与参数量大得多的商业系统统计上相当的性能，同时在 CPU 上的推理速度快 3.4 倍。
en_tdlr: Without changing any of the Gemma 4 speech encoder's weights, a lightweight CTC reader or a few low-rank adapter parameters achieve Saudi and Gulf Arabic speech recognition statistically on par with a far larger commercial system, while running 3.4x faster on CPU.
